categories.name: IDR Stablecoin
categories.content: A IDR stablecoin is a type of cryptocurrency that is designed to maintain a stable value by being pegged to the Indonesian rupiah.

categories.name: Printr Launchpad
categories.content: Printr is chain-abstracted token launchpad with customizable fee models and an on-chain 'Proof of Belief' staking mechanism that rewards long-term community commitment.

categories.name: Surge Launchpad
categories.content: Tokens launched via Surge, a multichain "Internet Capital Markets" platform designed for AI-native startups and revenue-generating businesses.

categories.name: ERC20i
categories.content: ERC20i is a token standard on Base blockchain that extends the capabilities of ERC-20 tokens by adding native inscriptions.

categories.name: Decentralized Lottery
categories.content: A decentralized lottery is a blockchain-based lottery system that conducts draws through smart contracts.

categories.name: Quest-to-Earn
categories.content: Quest-to-Earn refers to a gamified system in which users complete specific tasks or challenges to earn rewards, which can be in the form of points, tokens, or other incentives.

categories.name: DRC-20
categories.content: DRC-20 is a token standard on the Dogecoin blockchain that allows for the creation of tokens that represent ownership of assets.

categories.name: Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed
categories.content: The Moltbook and Openclaw-Themed category features community-driven assets representing specific agent personas or viral narratives (memes) within the Moltbook platform.

categories.name: Animal Racing
categories.content: Animal racing tokens are digital tokens used in virtual animal racing games.

categories.name: Kumbaya Launchpad
categories.content: Kumbaya is a community-first DEX and launchpad designed as a high-performance hub for 'cult' tokens and cultural assets.

categories.name: HyperXpad Launchpad
categories.content: HyperXpad Launchpad is a platform for crypto projects to hold Initial DEX Offerings (IDOs). Participants are able to gain early access to public and special token sales on the platform.

categories.name: Bridged DAI
categories.content: Bridged DAI refers to DAI that has been transferred from its native blockchain to a different blockchain through "bridging'.

categories.name: Bridged Stablecoin
categories.content: Bridged stablecoin refers to a stablecoin that has been transferred, or “bridged,” from one blockchain to another, typically through the use of a blockchain bridge.

categories.name: topblast.lol Ecosystem
categories.content: topblast.lol is a launchpad on The Open Network (TON), integrating fair-launch mechanics with a comprehensive Telegram-native DeFi ecosystem.

categories.name: daos.fun Ecosystem
categories.content: daos.fun Ecosystem consists of tokens that have active hedge funds on daos.fun.

categories.name: MXN Stablecoin
categories.content: Stablecoins that maintain a stable value by reference to the Mexican peso (MXN).

categories.name: Wormhole Assets
categories.content: The Wormhole project is a bidirectional, decentralized SPL token bridge between Solana and EVM chains.

categories.name: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Product (ETPs)
categories.content: The Tokenized Exchange-Traded Products (ETPs) category includes cryptoassets that represent on-chain versions of traditional Exchange-Traded Products (ETPs). ETPs are traditional financial securities that track underlying securities, an index, or other financial products.

categories.name: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs)
categories.content: Tokenized Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) refers to digital representation of exchange-traded funds such as SPY, GLD, TQQQ, XLK, VXUS on a blockchain platform.

categories.name: Remora Markets Tokenized rStocks
categories.content: Remora Markets Tokenized rStocks are on-chain tokens that represent economic exposure to traditional stocks, with each token typically backed 1:1 by the underlying security held through a regulated custodian
